dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: The books here are really interesting. They're full of twists and turns that all but defy even my intuition.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: I can't help but think this domain is a detective's mortal foe... Without a crime, there can be no deduction, and even the greatest storms simply rage on unchecked...

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: But then I remember that all this is to help you. And that's what makes this long grind worth it, right?
